description: One-call, site-bound hazard + environmental profile with an explainable 0-100 risk score. Geocodes an address (or takes lat/lon) then fans out to FEMA flood zone, recent FEMA disaster declarations (county), active NWS alerts, USGS earthquakes within 50km, EPA ECHO regulated facilities (by ZIP/state), and parcel records (Maryland statewide / Texas-Harris County only). The score starts at 100 and subtracts itemized deductions (flood SFHA, active alerts, declarations, EPA non-compliance, strong quakes). A failing source is noted, not fatal. Premium cross-source synthesis; not a substitute for a professional site assessment.

address.description: Full US street address to geocode.

lat.description: Latitude (use with lon instead of address).

lon.description: Longitude (use with lat instead of address).
